title: Number Wild Zone map items and link them with tick lists
consolidation_note: PR base is #3's branch, not main. 146 numbered approximate points;111 candidate links/35 ambiguous; preserve264 IDs. Candidate numbering/controller not verified deployed. Reconcile with AT333 compact dots and AT334 source crosswalk; do not certify positions from name/zone match.
original_pr_description:
## Goal
A player should see item **#07** on a Wild Zone map, identify **#07** in the nearby mapped-pickup tick list, tap **Find #07** to focus the location, and tick that item without confusing it with another pickup.

## Implementation
- Index **146 unique recorded map pins across all 20 Wild Zones** with stable per-zone #01, #02 etc. labels, preserving the original approximate coordinates and item names.
- Selected-zone city overlay + **enlarged numbered close-up** cloned from the recovered mission map, to distinguish overlapping pins without fabricating positions. Find #NN expands the close-up and focuses the matching pin.
- Display a **matching numbered mapped-item tick list** for each selected zone, with accessible pin buttons and checkboxes.
- Show **Item 01** etc. on every original item checklist row (264 original entries untouched). Display **Map #NN** only when name/zone match is uniquely attributable to an original entry.
- Sync the **111 uniquely matched** map/checklist pairs through existing progress state. The **35 ambiguous** pins retain distinct device-local tracking and display *Map match unverified* instead of guessing.
- Keep vendor rewards, random drops, and other unmapped entries in the original checklist without inventing map markers.
- Improve map panel's item location preview, mobile labels, legend/explanation and CSS.
- Add an index manifest, controller, audit document and regression checks; update `src/template.html`, editable section files and generated `index.html` together.

## Evidence
- Code-level audit: **20/20** zones, **146/146** IDs unique, **111** unambiguous matches, **35** flagged, **264** source checklist IDs preserved, all map coordinates within valid recorded ranges.
- Preserved **42** missions, **203** side/EX tasks and **232** recovered Pokédex cards.
- Local Chromium interaction tests: Zone 1 displays 8 numbered pins/rows; Zone 2 displays 4; map checkbox synchronises with original checklist where uniquely matched; Find #NN expands and focuses the original numbered close-up. Desktop and phone static renders created without JS errors.
- **Still required before merge:** integrated branch CI/static test, manual phone/browser QA, and in-game verification of the 35 ambiguous matches and approximate roof/ground locations.

## Dependence / no-loss rule
This branch is built **on top of draft PR #3**, so base this PR on `content/early-story-linked-playthrough-2026-11-21`. Merge in dependency order only after verification, or rebase carefully with exact changes and preserving all current source.
No writes to Supabase, no DNS/Render changes, no changes to Stream Bandit/TCG, and no change to the existing live ChatGPT Site or current `main` preview.
